title: Business Capital
description: Flexible growth capital with clear payback logic.
detail: For operators who need speed and simplicity—working capital, expansion, inventory, and marketing scale with terms you can explain.

title: Revenue-Based Financing
description: Repay as you earn—aligned to real revenue curves.
detail: Best for brands with consistent sales cycles. Payments flex with revenue, reducing stress during seasonality.

title: Asset-Backed
description: Use assets as leverage—equipment, inventory, receivables.
detail: Structure funding against tangible value. Useful when assets are strong but equity is expensive.

title: Non-Dilutive Startup
detail: For early-stage teams optimizing for time. Structured options that preserve cap table integrity.

title: Startup Capital
description: Strategic financing for momentum and milestones.
detail: Designed for teams with clear milestones—bridge funding, growth lines, and structured options to maintain control.

title: E-commerce Financing
description: Inventory and marketing scale without dilution.
detail: Built for paid acquisition cycles and inventory turns. Structured to protect margin and maintain flexibility.

title: SaaS Financing
detail: For recurring revenue businesses. Options designed around retention, CAC payback, and efficient scaling.

title: Credit Building
description: Strengthen your profile for better terms over time.
detail: A guided path to improve credit signals—helpful for companies graduating to more favorable structures.
